title: Ownership Under Ambiguity
question: Tell me about a time when you had to take ownership of an ambiguous problem without clear guidance.

rubric.name: situation_context
rubric.description: Clearly explains the ambiguous situation, key constraints, and why action was needed.

rubric.name: ownership_initiative
rubric.description: Explicitly details individual responsibility, decision-making, and proactivity.

rubric.name: action_quality
rubric.description: Describes concrete steps taken, structured approach, and reasoning.

rubric.name: measurable_impact
rubric.description: Provides quantitative or clear qualitative outcomes and impact.

rubric.name: reflection
rubric.description: Demonstrates self-awareness and lessons learned for future situations.

expected_signals: Distinguishes personal contribution from general team effort
Highlights concrete outcome or impact metrics
red_flags: Blames team members or leadership for ambiguity
Gives generic statements without concrete personal actions
follow_up_prompts: What specific decision did you make that had the greatest impact on the outcome?
Looking back, what risk did you take, and how would you mitigate it differently now?
